shared.style: extreme macro photograph, framed so close that only two or three elements of the subject fill the entire frame and every one of them bleeds off at least two edges — the subject should be barely identifiable, read as light and shape first and as an object second. Depth of field so shallow that one narrow band holds focus and everything else melts into soft bokeh. A single warm amber light source, everything else falling away to near-black. Deep shadow detail, fine photographic grain, dark moody editorial still-life photography.
